narrative: 一条熟悉的走廊可以变成一个失稳的物理系统。当人物依然保有重量感、表面依然坚实时，这种效果最为强烈：人们之所以能在墙上行走，是因为片场或摄影机重新定义了“上方”的方向。
如果只想表达15度左右的轻微不安感，这不是合适的工具；如果只是在后期把画面倾斜、没有任何重量感，同样不适用。一张倾斜的静帧不等于一个物理旋转的房间。
how: 要么让摄影机围绕光轴持续横滚，要么搭建一个旋转片场，并精心设计摄影机与它的相对关系。实拍需要经过工程设计的场景、固定牢靠的道具，以及特技统筹的配合。
提示词：a full camera roll, the frame rotating as if the world has lost its up, or a rotating corridor with weighted bodies.
when: 在重力可以被打破的情境中使用它。具体例子：一场发生在酒店走廊的打斗，地板逐渐变成了墙壁。
不要把只需要一个荷兰角（Dutch Angle）的安静对话戏也拿去做摄影机横滚。
vs: 荷兰角滚转（Dutch Roll）是缓慢过渡到倾斜角度的过程；荷兰角（Dutch Angle）则是一个固定不动的倾斜画面。
360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）是在偏航方向上围绕主体转圈，改变的是方位角，而不是让地平线绕镜头旋转。摄影机横滚关乎“上下”互换，而不是绕着某人走一圈。
examples_film: 《盗梦空间》（Inception）的酒店走廊打斗戏使用了旋转片场，人物始终保有重量感。《2001太空漫游》（2001: A Space Odyssey）则穿行于环形飞船内部，让人物在环状结构中行走从而重新定义了“下方”。
要把旋转的房间和单纯的倾斜调色区分开。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是荷兰角或360°环绕。破绽在于：画面只是一个静止的倾斜角度，或者摄影机在转圈时地平线基本保持水平。
解决办法：围绕镜头轴横滚，或者旋转整个房间，直到“上方”不再是画面的顶部。

faq.q: 电影中的摄影机横滚（Camera Roll）是什么？
faq.a: 它是围绕镜头轴的旋转（或旋转片场），使地平线随之转动，“上方”不再稳定。

faq.q: 摄影机横滚（Camera Roll）与荷兰角滚转（Dutch Roll）的区别
faq.a: 荷兰角滚转是让水平画面缓缓过渡到倾斜角度；摄影机横滚则把这个想法推向极致，直到重力本身受到质疑，有时甚至用旋转的房间来实现，而不只是一个小幅倾斜。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用摄影机横滚？
faq.a: 当故事本身已经脱离了重力：飞船、梦境建筑、一个忘记了地板存在的舞池。不要把它当作制造不安感的默认选择。

faq.q: 如何为 AI 图像或视频撰写摄影机横滚的提示词？
faq.a: 描述摄影机围绕镜头轴持续横滚，或者一个旋转房间中依然保有重量感的人物。要说明清楚是片场在转，还是只有摄影机在转。

narrative: A familiar corridor can become an unstable physical system. The effect is strongest when bodies retain weight and surfaces remain solid: people walk on walls because the set or the camera has rewritten up.
It is the wrong tool for a 15-degree unease, and the wrong tool if you only tilted the image in post with no sense of mass. A tilted still is not a room physically rotating.
how: Either roll the camera continuously around the optical axis, or build a rotating set and keep the camera's relationship designed. Practical work needs engineered sets, restrained objects, and stunt coordination.
Prompt a full camera roll, the frame rotating as if the world has lost its up, or a rotating corridor with weighted bodies.
when: Use it when gravity is optional. Concrete beat: a fight in a hotel corridor whose floor becomes a wall.
Do not roll a quiet dialogue that only needed a Dutch.
vs: A Dutch Roll is a slow transition into a cant. A Dutch Angle is frozen.
An 360-Degree Orbit circles a subject in yaw, changing azimuth, not rolling the horizon around the lens. Camera roll is about up and down swapping, not about walking around someone.
examples_film: Inception 's hotel corridor fight is a rotating set with weighted bodies. 2001: A Space Odyssey moves through circular spacecraft interiors so walking in a ring redefines down.
Distinguish the rotating room from a simple tilted grade.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dutch Angle or an 360-Degree Orbit. The tell is a still cant, or a camera circling while the horizon stays mostly level.
The fix: roll around the lens axis, or rotate the room, until up is no longer the top of the frame.

faq.q: What is Camera Roll in film?
faq.a: It is rotation around the lens axis (or a rotating set) so the horizon turns and up is no longer stable.
Dutch roll eases a level frame into a cant. Camera roll continues the idea until gravity is in question, sometimes with a revolving room rather than a small tilt.

faq.q: When should I use Camera Roll?
faq.a: When the story has unhooked gravity: spacecraft, dream architecture, a dance floor that forgets the floor. Do not use it as a default unease.

faq.q: How do I prompt Camera Roll for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write camera rolls continuously around its lens axis, or a rotating room with weighted bodies. Name whether the set turns or only the camera.
